verdict.rationale: Treasury documents that every movement of funds creates a Transaction object, which serves as a ledger entry. These entries are intended for building account activity feeds and reconciliation, and are linked to flow objects such as ReceivedDebit and OutboundPayment, with transaction-created events. This shows a structured, object-based transaction feed with identifiable records. However, nothing in the evidence describes counterparty fields, rail-specific metadata or data enrichment. Missing for 10: documented counterparty details on transactions, rail-specific (ACH/wire) metadata fields, merchant/enrichment data, explicit stable-identifier guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
